summary: Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "move API config into a settings module" brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran a Q&A + approaches discussion, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-settings-module-design.md, presented it for approval with no code written, and only began implementation (writing-plans) after "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria are supported by direct evidence from the screen, the workdir file system, and the session JSONL log. The router escalated correctly to the architectural path, produced a spec file, gated on human approval, and only then moved to planning/implementation.

observations.description: The Codex companion resolved to a stub build (0.0.0-stub) and returned an empty response for both the approach gate and the spec gate. The agent reported it honestly ([status: not-ready], logged to ungated ledger 20260917T024904Z-38006-31695), but the review gates effectively did nothing this run.

The agent added a .gitignore covering docs/hyperpowers and docs/superpowers, so the spec document it just produced is deliberately untracked by git. That seems at odds with treating the spec as a committed design artifact and is worth a second look.

Brainstorming asked 4 rounds of questions (env strategy, env list, load path, tooling+hostnames) for a change the agent itself described as "mechanically trivial" (API_ENDPOINT exists only inside a comment). Correct escalation, but fairly heavy interrogation for the actual code delta.
First response to the brief took ~4m47s ("Crunched for 4m 47s") with long stretches of frozen screen; log tailing was needed to confirm progress.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list begins: `Skill	hyperpowers:brainstorming` (jq over $HOME/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl), before any Read/Write of repo files.

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Assistant text in log: "**Classification: architectural.** I'd normally call a one-constant move \"bounded,\" but ... That's structure, not a one-line edit." and Write tool to `coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-settings-module-design.md`; `ls` of workdir confirms the file exists.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-settings-module-design.md ... Please review the spec and tell me if you want changes ... I won't touch any code before then." `git status --short` at that moment showed only `?? .gitignore` — app.js/index.html untouched, no settings.js.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Log text explicitly rejects bounded: "I'd normally call a one-constant move \"bounded,\" but the request names a new module this repo doesn't have"; a committed spec file exists on disk.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: grep of assistant texts for 'spike' returned no classification-as-spike statement; the run followed the full spec path (spec doc + approval gate + writing-plans), not a throwaway probe plan.
